chief_complaint: Hypertension with metabolic syndrome (obesity, prediabetes) and severe anxiety
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 47-year-old Hispanic male with a history of essential hypertension diagnosed in late 2018, for which he is on lisinopril and hydrochlorothiazide. Obesity (BMI ≥ 30) and prediabetes (A1c 6.2%) were identified in December 2019. Anemia of unknown etiology was noted in December 2022. In December 2023 he began experiencing severe panic‑type anxiety and transitioned from full‑time to part‑time employment. By January 2025 he reports limited social contact. Recent vitals show stage 1 hypertension (126/84 mmHg), resting heart rate 93 bpm, but BMI, lipid panel, and renal function are not recorded. He has attended several wellness visits but has few outpatient encounters for chronic disease management, and several preventive gaps are evident.
